receipts.scope: No allrepo types/tests/games/model/network. Newfixture failures and tooling first failures preserved in handoff/logs; author receipt only, not peer execution.

limits: Fresh actualGit before, independent complete void AST walker counts and both complete emits. No type/runtime/gate repeated.
Only exact source literal dynamic route inverse, no callback/literal/assertion/array masking.

manualReview.ownership: metadata clone plus decisions/checkpoints/events/settled/invalid/errors/turns remain original8carriers, single original Map identity per class; onChange/liveEvents original callback references retained. Source relocation does not introduce a lifecycle scheduler or cleanup framework.
manualReview.openingAndSettlement: turn is captured/set before pending entry; two ownedEventCursor property queries preserve getter/callback points. Opening append/onChange outside try. Await provider then full copyDecisionData then assertDelivery. Deferred scope can keep pending after decide returns; direct notification failure enters catch and re-increments settlement, original error rethrown unless that catch notice itself throws.
manualReview.finalization: build reads liveEvents, rejects before-last-checkpoint cursor, constructs original record and clones events, then invalid before pending, then full parseReproductionRecord. Schema owner retains strict v2 sourcehash/lockhash metadata and verifier gates; no weak compatibility or new format.
manualReview.copyPrivacy: Node proxy detection before ownSymbols/ownDescriptors reflection; no getter, toJSON or Proxy trap invoked for provider action copy. Normalization is original rest facts structuredClone, not an authorization or provider request replacement. Node import remains backend only.
manualReview.newSixTests: Expected turn/opening/settleOrder/error identity and scalarnames are hand-written; they initialize actual checkpoint input but do not derive expected trace results from trace. Coverage includes opening-notice pending, direct-notice catch twice, parallel completion, checkpoint before-write mismatch, committed clone, invalid-before-pending; no claim full causal game or deferred-delivery suite coverage.
manualReview.comments: Current head correctly says return may precede delivery callback; catch comment distinguishes future callback exception from current try. Comment issue raised by Root and this reviewer was resolved before finalSHA; no source delta since independent proof.

rootReview.scope: 8因果载体/metadata clone/turn与settle顺序、2cursorgetter、outsideTry opening通知/同步double++、deferred return-first与后parse严格边界、Node拒Proxy优先reflection、schema无反export
